summary: 61-year-old New Mexico woman backcountry skiing with her dog overdue on the Grand Mesa; reported missing ~9:30 p.m. Tuesday with her car at the Mesa Top trailhead, found alive ~4:30 a.m. Wednesday several miles out by a snowmobile team; overnight low near -15°F, treated on scene for exposure
responding_agency: Mesa County Sheriff's Office; Mesa County Search and Rescue (Snowskipper team); CareFlight helicopter
notes: Date inferred: MCSO release gives only "9:30 Tuesday night" / "4:30 in the morning"; corroborating report says "late Tuesday night... 9:30 Tuesday evening... 4:30 Wednesday morning" in an article updated 2022-02-03, so Tuesday = 2022-02-01. Search spanned Feb 1 evening into Feb 2 morning; folded into one row dated the mission start. One search team became stranded when snowmobile electronics froze and was located en route to help.
